messages.subject: [Scheduled] DMS maintenance window - Sat 7 Feb 22:00-02:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system (FileSite) and the firm VPN will be unavailable this Saturday between 22:00 and 02:00 for a scheduled storage upgrade. Please save and close all documents before 21:45. Email will remain available throughout.

If you have an urgent need for access during the window, raise a P1 ticket via the portal.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
